verdict: Relative streaming can genuinely pump growing modes. This establishes a possible class of pumps, not MOND, nonlinear saturation, chirality, or 32pi.
limitations: Cold electrostatic plasma with a fixed neutralizer; not the full non-Abelian medium
All longitudinal dipoles are parallel in a single wave and give zero cross product
Vacuum frequency and MOND acceleration identifications are additional assumptions
No universal velocity or density selected
